lines.text: Kestrel Two. This is Command.
lines.synthesisText: Kestrel Two. This is Command.

lines.text: Command! Kestrel Two, go ahead!
lines.synthesisText: Command! Kestrel Two, go ahead!

lines.speaker: kestrel
lines.text: Understood! We'll get it done!

lines.text: Hammer Three. Command.
lines.synthesisText: Hammer Three. Command.

lines.text: Take your assigned compound. Clear it, then hold.

lines.synthesisText: [firm, brisk voice] Clear your assigned sector. Watch your spacing.

lines.text: Command! We've got contact!
lines.synthesisText: [shouting] [strained, breathless voice] Command! We've got contact!

lines.speaker: kestrel
lines.text: Pulling back! Stay together!
lines.synthesisText: [shouting] [strained, breathless voice] Pulling back! Stay together!

lines.speaker: kestrel
lines.text: Check your fire! You're hitting us!
lines.synthesisText: [shouting] [strained, breathless voice] Check your fire! You're hitting us!

lines.speaker: kestrel
lines.text: Enemy mech! Get into cover!
lines.synthesisText: [shouting] [strained, breathless voice] Enemy mech! Get into cover!

lines.speaker: kestrel
lines.text: Target down! Keep your eyes up!
lines.synthesisText: [shouting] [strained, breathless voice] Target down! Keep your eyes up!

lines.speaker: kestrel
lines.text: Still with you, Command!
lines.synthesisText: [shouting] [strained, breathless voice] Still with you, Command!

lines.speaker: kestrel
lines.text: Keep your heads down! Pick your shots!
lines.synthesisText: [shouting] [strained, breathless voice] Keep your heads down! Pick your shots!

lines.speaker: hammer
lines.text: Contact! Find cover!
lines.synthesisText: [projecting, gravelly voice] Contact! Find cover!

lines.speaker: hammer
lines.text: We're falling back. Nobody goes alone.
lines.synthesisText: [projecting, gravelly voice] We're falling back. Nobody goes alone.

lines.speaker: hammer
lines.text: Check fire! Those are our people!
lines.synthesisText: [projecting, gravelly voice] Check fire! Those are our people!

lines.speaker: hammer
lines.text: Mech on the field. Watch those guns.
lines.synthesisText: [projecting, gravelly voice] Mech on the field. Watch those guns.

lines.text: That's one down. Keep at it.
lines.synthesisText: [projecting, gravelly voice] That's one down. Keep at it.

lines.text: Still in the fight, Command.
lines.synthesisText: [projecting, gravelly voice] Still in the fight, Command.

lines.text: Short bursts. Make them count.
lines.synthesisText: [projecting, gravelly voice] Short bursts. Make them count.

lines.text: Contact! Heads down!
lines.synthesisText: [shouting] [strained voice] Contact! Heads down!

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Back! Move together. Keep moving!
lines.synthesisText: [shouting] [strained voice] Back! Move together. Keep moving!

lines.text: Still with you, Command.
lines.synthesisText: [shouting] [strained voice] Still with you, Command.
